module_summary: Complete 64-bit IP stack: an eth_type classifier routes incoming frames to IP or ARP children, the IP block resolves MACs via the ARP engine, and an arbiter mux merges their outgoing frames.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Incoming Ethernet header valid, steered to IP or ARP by classifier.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Incoming Ethernet payload broadcast to IP and ARP receivers.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload valid gating select registers and routed to selected child.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready muxed from selected child, or always ready for dropped frames.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready muxed from IP/ARP child by eth_type select.

anchors.name: s_eth_type
anchors.why: EtherType field decoded to select IP or ARP path.

anchors.name: s_select_ip
anchors.why: EtherType 0x0800 decode routing header to the IP block.

anchors.name: s_select_arp
anchors.why: EtherType 0x0806 decode routing header to the ARP block.

anchors.name: s_select_none
anchors.why: Unknown EtherType; frame accepted and dropped.

anchors.name: s_select_ip_reg
anchors.why: Per-frame latched route steering payload valid/ready to IP block.

anchors.name: s_select_arp_reg
anchors.why: Per-frame latched route steering payload to ARP block.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Outgoing Ethernet payload from arbiter mux of IP and ARP transmitters.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Outgoing Ethernet header valid from arbiter mux.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: IP payload to transmit, framed by IP block.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Outgoing IP header valid into IP block.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received IP payload output by IP parser.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Received IP header valid from IP block.

anchors.name: arp_request_valid
anchors.why: IP block request to ARP engine for destination MAC lookup.

anchors.name: arp_request_ip
anchors.why: IP address to resolve sent to ARP engine.

anchors.name: arp_response_valid
anchors.why: ARP engine response valid back to IP block.

anchors.name: arp_response_mac
anchors.why: Resolved MAC address returned to IP block.

anchors.name: ip_rx_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload valid into IP block gated by IP select register.

anchors.name: arp_rx_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload valid into ARP block gated by ARP select register.

anchors.name: ip_tx_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: IP block outgoing frame payload into arbiter mux.

anchors.name: arp_tx_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: ARP block outgoing frame payload into arbiter mux.

anchors.name: rx_busy
anchors.why: IP receive busy indication.

anchors.name: tx_error_arp_failed
anchors.why: Transmit dropped because ARP resolution failed.

anchors.name: local_mac
anchors.why: Local MAC address configuration for IP and ARP.

anchors.name: local_ip
anchors.why: Local IP address configuration for IP and ARP.

anchors.name: clear_arp_cache
anchors.why: Command to clear the ARP cache.

groups.name: rx_classifier
groups.description: EtherType classifier routing incoming frames to IP, ARP or drop.

groups.name: ip_block
groups.description: IPv4 RX parser and TX framer with ARP-based MAC resolution.

groups.name: arp_block
groups.description: ARP engine with cache answering IP block MAC lookups.

groups.name: tx_arbiter
groups.description: Frame arbiter merging IP and ARP outgoing Ethernet frames.
